----------------------------------------------------------------

I've gone overboard again, and when I go overboard, it usually means a lot of content for you guys. AOE2 Part 1 was a little project from my heart because I had a lot of fun with the novel and enjoyed talking to TJ about where there was room for improvement.

Sometimes I had to think about how best to adapt a story like this into a comic, but then I figured it would be best to leave out the complicated stuff and focus a little more on the characters lol

If you feel like reading the original, I'll leave you a link to TJ's account, where the chapters are being published bit by bit, while I'll be tackling the whole thing Part by Part.
Novel: https://www.pixiv.net/novel/show.php?id=26454187

And thanks again for the opportunity to make this comic, not only because I like AOE so much, but also because it was a good learning experience. For example, I now know that I shouldn't underestimate over 600 pages!

There's a bonus comic for AOE Part 1 on my Fanbox, feel free to check it out!
